article.story: RIVERSIDE, Calif. -- — Dominique Daniels Jr. had 22 points in Cal Baptist's 87-48 victory over Abilene Christian on Thursday. Daniels had three steals for the Lancers (22-8, 12-5 Western Athletic Conference). Martel Williams scored 10 points while finishing 4 of 8 from the floor. Bradey Henige shot 4 of 5 from the field to finish with nine points. Bradyn Hubbard led the way for the Wildcats (13-17, 5-12) with 14 points. No other player finished in double figures for the Wildcats. The Lancers led 49-19 at the half, taking the lead for good just 1:10 into the game. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
